text:
Eleanor: Thanks for joining todays all-hands. Posting slides + quick follow-ups here: https://drive.redwood.ai/all-hands/sep-2024. Drop Qs or action items below.

Noah: Quick clarify on Dedicated GAs rollback policy  if a rollout hits errors, does traffic auto-fallback to Hosted or pause? @Eleanor

Eleanor: Default behavior = pause rollout and mark incidents; auto-fallback to a hosted compatible model is optional and off by default. Customers can enable fallback policy in Console.

Priya: Action: I'll add a short note in the Runbook about enabling fallback + caveats (data egress, cost). ETA Wed.

Diego: Can we get a short ops checklist for migrating customers to Dedicated? Sales needs it for pre-sales calls.

Mina: I'll draft a 1-page checklist: DB cutover steps, cache warming, SLO smoke tests. Will share link once ready.

Eleanor: Owners: Priya (runbook note), Mina (migration checklist), Noah (SLO examples). Please add items to the follow-ups sheet: https://sheets.redwood.ai/d/sep-followups by EOD Fri. Ping me for blockers.

all-hands-bot: Recording & transcript uploaded: https://zoom.redwood.ai/rec/sep24.

Noah: Small UX ask: can Console surface the rollout toggle near the model card? makes demos easier.

Priya: UX + Product to scope a small placement change. I'll put a placeholder in the doc and tag design.

Eleanor: Closing thread for now  if more Qs, add to the sheet or DM me. Thanks!
